Department ofPharmacy， Zhongshan Ophthalmological Center， Sun Yat-sen Universit， Guangzhou 51000， China.【Abstract】Objective Through collating and analyzing the examples of ophthalmic drug consultation and the trends in the past 10 years， the function and the skills that need to be improved of clinical pharmacists in ophthalmology are discussed.Methods 126 medicine consultation data in our hospital were drew randomly and analyzed and summarized according to consultation content. Results Compared with the content of drug counseling in 2008 ～ 2009， the proportion of consultations for medical workers increased by 9.99%. The content of the consultations mainly decreased by 11.11% in usage and dosage， decreased by 9.55% in adverse reactions， and increased by 4.76% in Medication for special populations ，The drug allocation plan increased by 3.97%， and rationality of medication increased by 8.73%. Conclusion In the information age，pharmacists need to improve their comprehensive skills to meet the needs of clinical medications and provide direct， responsible， drug-related services for the public， to improve the safety， effectiveness and economy of medications.药物咨询是提高患者用药依从性，确保医护人员高效准确地获取相关药物信息的最快捷方式 [1]，构建药学服务新模式中 [2]，药物咨询更是公众对药物需求的反馈窗口和建立良好医患关系的桥梁 [3-4]。
